query: SELECT DISTINCT harness as "harness!" FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(entry)='string' THEN entry #>> '{}' ELSE entry->>'name' END AS harness FROM public.client_status c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.harnesses)='array' THEN c.harnesses ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) entry WHERE c.organization_id=$1 ) available WHERE harness IS NOT NULL AND harness <> '' ORDER BY harness
